buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 2. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 3. Generic Installation, Commissioning, Testing, Configuration, Training (if any - which ever is applicable as per scope of supply) is to be carried out by OEM / OEM Certified resource or OEM authorised Reseller. 4. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 5. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 6. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited (AVNL) - Vehicle Factory Jabalpur payable at Jabalpur . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date.

7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited (AVNL) - Vehicle Factory Jabalpur . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of Armoured Vehicles Nigam Limited (AVNL) - Vehicle Factory Jabalpur A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 9. Experience/Past Performance criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through re-seller(s)} should have manufactured and supplie d same or similar Category Products for 1 number quantity, in at least one o f the last seven Financial years before the bid opening date. Bidder are required to submit Installation& Commissioning Certificat e / CRAC/ Performance Certificate /JCC for successful supplying, installing and commissioning of same /similar type product in respect to experience and past performance Submission of copy of supply order only is not suffi cient. 2 . Firm need to comply the technical specification. For doing this f irm need to write “complied’ in front of technical specification and then put h is company’s seal and sign. 1 . Bidder must submit an undertaking that they are not banned, de barred, or suspended from doing business with any Government of India de partment, State Government, or Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) 2 . Bidder financial standing:- The bidder should not be under liq uidation ,court receivership or similar proceedings and should not be bankru pt . Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 3 . “The tooled up components drawings will be provided to th e firm through Mail/GeM as per the request of the bidder only after the submission of the NDC certificate (Non Disclosure Certificate ) i n prescribed format to VFJ.”

3 . Delivery Period:-180days from the date of placement of contra ct. In case of delay in supplies LD will be applicable as per GeM/ATC conditio n. Delivery would include supply, transportation, installation, commissioning and signing of commissioning report by GO (user section). In case of delay (a ttributable to the supplier) in these activities beyond delivery period, Liquida ted Damages would be imposed at specified rate. 4 . Successful bidder will be required to submit performance security within 30 days of effective date contract for due performance of contract wh ere the contract value is more than Rs.10 lakhs. The amount of performance security will be 3% of contract value in Indian Rupees. 5 . Payment T&C : Up-to 80% value of material plus 100% Taxes & Duties, as mentioned i n Supply order, will be paid after acceptance in Pre-Dispatch Inspectio n of machine at Firm’s works and on receipt of machine in safe conditi on by consignee against submission of PBG cum Warranty Bond amou nting to 3% of contract value valid up to 60 days beyond the expiry of warranty period in the prescribed format. (Note:- 3%of Performance Se curity Deposit (PSD)/ Security Deposit(SD)/ Performance Bank Guarant ee (PBG)cum Warranty bond furnished by the supplier to the purchaser after award of contract as security for performance of contract includin g warranty obligation). Balance value of material (without any further element of taxes on mat erial as the same is paid fully with 80% payment of material) plus100% Erection &Commissioning (E&C) including supervision charg es and taxes after commissioning and final acceptance of machine at p urchaser’s end.. 6 . Pre - Dispatch Inspection: The authorized representatives of CG M, VFJ will carry out Pre - dispatch inspection of the machine at firm’s pre mises. The firm shall give intimation 30 days in advance to enable VFJ to dep ute its representative for carrying out pre-dispatch inspection and other con dition is as mention in ATC. 7 . Warranty: Warranty is 12 months from the date of commissioni ng and acceptance of the plant/equipment at the purchaser’s site. 8 . Liquidated Damages (LD)/GeM: In the event of seller’s failure to have the plant / machines or any part / co nsignment thereof within the period prescribed for delivery in the contract , the buyer may at his discretion withhold any payment until the whole of t he plant / machines have been supplied and the buyer may also deduct fr om the seller, Liquidated Damages and not by way of penalty, the sum of The standard Liquidated Damages percentageis 0.5% + GST of the contra ct price of the delayed supplies per week or part thereof for which the del ay has occurred, subject to maximum of 5% + GST of the value of delayed supplies. For delay in completion of any works or services attributable to the supplier, which leads to delay in commissioning and final acceptance of th e plant / machines, LD will be imposed @ 0.5% + GST of the full contract p rice of the plant / machines for each and every week and part of a week of delay in commissioning and final acceptance, subject to maximum of 5% + GST of the full contract price. This LD will be in addition to the LD agains t delay in delivery of supplies.

The sum of LD for (a and b) i.e., for delays in supplies as well as works &services, will be subject to overall ceiling of 10% + GST of full contract pr ice excluding taxes & duties. 9 . In the Price bid, the bidder shall include all elements of cost of Plant and Equipment strictly as per the scope of supply & services specified i n technical specification. If the work is of turn-key nature, the vendor will be responsible for complete execution of the plants including construction of bu ildings and civil / electrical /instrumentation / mechanical works as specified in the scope of work. 1 0 . "The successful bidder shall furnish a Bank Guarantee (BG) for an amount equivalent to 110% of the cost of the tooled-up component i.e. Rs. 1 0,32,179/-. The BG shall remain valid for the entire warranty period plus an a dditional two (2) months, as per the tender conditions. 1 1 . Purpose: A Pre-Bid conference will be held with the interested Bidders either t hrough Physical mode or through virtual mode over video conferencing for the purpose of holdingtechnical specifications, scope of work, and commercial ter ms, discussions and providing clarifications by the Purchaser. b. Submission of Queries: Any clarification(s) and/or deviation(s) proposed by t he bidder for discussion during the Pre-Bid Conference shall be submitted strict ly in writing or through email to abhilashdeepjain@ord.gov.in in at least two (02) days prior to the scheduled date of the Pre-Bid Conference. It shall be con clusively presumed that no clarification or deviation exists in case the same is not received within the stipulated time. No oral queries, late submissions, or re quests raised during or after the Pre-Bid Conference shall be entertained under any circumstances. c. The date, time, and venue of the pre-bid meeting shall be as stipulated in the GeM Bid ddocument. In the event that a bidder is unable to attend the pre-bid meeting in person, participation through virtual mode shall be permitted. Howe ver, such bidders shall intimate their willingness to attend the meeting virtuall y at least two (02) days prior to the scheduled date of the meeting through em ail (Online meeting details will be provided to the firm one day earlier). d. Based upon the discussion held in the Pre-Bid Conference, if required, a Corrige ndum/Addendum shall be issued in GeM Portal and it shall be treated as a part of the Tender document. However, the decision of the purchaser in this regard will be final. e. No further Pre-Bid suggestions for clarifications/deviations will be entertained a fter the Pre-Bid Conference. f. Implied Acceptance: The act of submission of the tender shall be deemed to constitute unconditional, unequivocal, and irrevocable acceptance of all terms,

conditions, stipulations, and requirements of the bid document. It shall be conc lusively presumed that the bidder has carefully examined, fully understood, an d accepted without any deviation whatsoever the technical specifications, sco pe of work, commercial terms, and all contractual provisions. No claim, represe ntation, clarification, or request for amendment arising out of ignorance, misun derstanding, or misinterpretation of the bid documents shall be entertained at any stage of the tendering process or thereafter g. No Post-Bid Claims: A firm cannot later claim they did not understand the sc ope of work or were unaware of site conditions to request a higher price or tim e extension. h. No Ignorance Plea: The bidder cannot later claim they did not understand th e technical requirements or were unaware of local conditions to justify cost ove rruns or delays. i. Comprehensive Pricing: The quote is assumed to include all taxes, duties, tr ansport, and hidden costs, making it a complete "turnkey" price. j. Binding Contract: Once a bid is accepted, this clause ensures the bidder can not negotiate new terms, as they are deemed to have accepted all conditions u pon submission. k. All the administrative & incidental expenses e.g. travelling, lodging and boardin g etc shall be borne by the bidders. . 10.
